HOW IT WORKS

From signal to sent email in one workspace.

No stitching together five tools. ChampHarbinger handles the full pipeline, start to finish.

01
Watch

ChampHarbinger tracks the web for the signals that mean a buyer is in motion.

02
Enrich

It finds the right companies and the right people inside them, verified and deduped.

03
Draft

It writes outreach grounded in the signal. You review, edit, and send.

CAPABILITIES

Built for teams that move first.

Everything from the first signal to the sent message, in a single chat-first workspace.

Signals engine

Continuous web monitoring for hiring changes, funding announcements, product launches, and review-sentiment shifts. Filter to the moves that matter.

Contact enrichment

Pull from the Champions Group database of 120M+ verified contacts and companies. AI-verified, deduplicated, and ready for outreach.

Outreach drafting

AI-drafted personalized messages grounded in the signal that surfaced the prospect. Edit, approve, and queue in one place.

Sequences

Multi-step email sequences with reply detection. Automated where it helps, manual where it matters.

Browser automation

Browserbase and Stagehand handle the long tail of web data. When the public API is missing, ChampHarbinger fetches it anyway.

Own your data

Bring your own Postgres. Bring your own LLM via OpenRouter: any model, any time. No vendor lock, no shared multi-tenant database.

WHY IT WORKS

Owned infrastructure, not another data reseller.

The signals, the contacts, and the model are all under your control. That is what makes the outreach defensible.

Backed by 12 Champions Group companies

ChampHarbinger draws on the same data infrastructure that powers Lake B2B, Ampliz, and the wider Champions Group network.

Your LLM, through OpenRouter

Route to any model, any time. ChampHarbinger never locks you to a single provider or a fixed price.

Your data, your Postgres

Bring your own database. No shared multi-tenant store, no data leaving infrastructure you control.

GET STARTED

The signals are already there. Find them first.

Cham
